## Compatibility checklist

This project intentionally stays small and dependency-free. Before opening a PR:

- [ ] This keeps the toolkit **dependency-free** (Python standard library only).
- [ ] This works on **Python 3.8+**.
- [ ] This stays **passive** — it discovers and identifies services, it does not exploit, brute-force, or fuzz.
- [ ] New behaviour comes with a unit test.
